ADDED 2026-10-08 BY A0 (/claude/a0_atlas) ON A1 RE-CHECK N-3 (evidence/WP-0A-CON-008/a1-recheck-2026-10-07.md §4; also C0 N-2, Q0 O-1, R0 RC-3 in their 2026-10-07 re-checks), OWNER WP-0A-CON-008 (its writable_paths hold scripts/refresh-author-handoff.mjs), GUARD INTEGRITY, NOT A CONDITION ON THIS PACKAGE'S MERGE: npm run check:handoff and test-kits/handoff-conformance.test.mjs compare the handoff's cited head with branchTipBefore(), which for a non-merge HEAD is always HEAD^, so that a handoff need not cite the commit that contains it. Nothing checks that HEAD is the handoff commit, so whatever the last commit carries is outside the comparison. Measured at e601ea28, whose handoff cited 8526ca67 and whose own commit modified work-packages/WP-0A-CON-008.json: check:handoff exited 0 and conformance passed 19 of 19, and CI read the same HEAD^. A green handoff guard is therefore evidence only when git show --stat HEAD shows the handoff alone. Fix sketch for the owner to decide: when HEAD does not modify handoffs/<package>-author-handoff.json, compare the cited head with HEAD itself, keep HEAD^ only for the commit that carries the refresh, and add a negative-control test in which a last commit that changes a manifest and not the handoff exits DRIFTED. Until then reviewers check the last-and-alone rule by hand.
